    1. SysMLinJavaQuantityKinds()

Class SysMLinJavaQuantityKinds

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.quantitykinds.SysMLQuantityKindsCollection
sysmlinjava.quantitykinds.SysMLinJavaQuantityKinds
public final class SysMLinJavaQuantityKinds extends SysMLQuantityKindsCollection
SysMLinJava representation of a collection of SysML quantityKinds. Included are the quantities of the SI prescribed in the SysML standard as well as a number of other quantities that are useful for SysMLinJava modeling. As static instances, the quantityKinds can be referenced in SysMLinJava code by simply referencing the class scope with the quantityKind name, e.g. 
quantityKind = SysMLinJavaQuantityKinds.Length;

Each SysMLinJavaQuantityKind instance is a static final instance in this final SysMLinJavaQuantityKind class to reflect the static nature of the SI quantities. Additional quantityKinds can be created outside of this SysMLinJavaQuantityKind class by creating a new class that is an extension of the SysMLQuantityKindsCollection class and declaring additional static final SysMLQuantityKind instances in the class, just as done in this class.

Note that individual instances of SysMLQuantityKind are self described by their individual field values, i.e. description and definitionURI.

ModelerOne
